summary: Implemented all 4 phases: nix, nvim, and epidemiology implementer SKILL.md files each now read completion_data (completion_summary/roadmap_items) out of .return-meta.json and call the shared skill_propagate_completion_summary writer, gated on the 'implemented' status the agents actually emit (not the dead 'completed' value). Phase 4 verified the caller/callee contract, confirmed zero .claude/ modifications, and recorded three deferred follow-ups in the implementation summary.
decisions_made: Gated all three call sites on 'implemented' (accepting 'completed') since all three agent files emit 'implemented', not 'completed', as their terminal status.
Made nix/nvim insertions self-contained, binding padded_num/project_name themselves since those files bind no bash variables anywhere.
Used literal task_type 'nix'/'neovim' verified against each skill's Trigger Conditions; epidemiology used its in-scope $task_type variable.
Left epidemiology's Stage 7 table row (mapping 'completed') unrepaired as a recorded observation; deferred the shared-script extraction as a follow-up.
